packageRules.description: The measured pipeline, pinned with == in pyproject.toml: the parser and its OCR engine, the dense encoder and the reranker, BM25, and the torch they run on. CI runs no ingest and loads no model, so a green build says nothing about what gold and campus measure. Approve the group in the session that re-measures them. A security fix still opens at once; before it merges, compare the parse and BM25 output of a few documents before and after.
Django stays on 5.2, the LTS that docs/architecture.md decides (Chosen stack) and the <6 bound in pyproject.toml holds. Moving past it is that decision revisited, not an update to approve.

katex is a direct dependency for its stylesheet alone (MathMarkdown.tsx); rehype-katex writes the markup and holds its own katex range. A bump of either one alone installs a second katex and pairs one version's stylesheet with the other's markup. Approve the two together once rehype-katex's range accepts the new katex (docs/security.md, accepted risks).
